comment: The connector tool roster the MCP-flavored skills projection is allowed to teach. `live` mirrors backend/moda_connector/tools/__init__.py MANIFEST on nullframe-studio origin/main. `pending_server` are best-guess names for the connector surface-parity wave (file/drive/search/template, website-read) that a sibling studio PR is landing — scripts/project-mcp.py check warns (and `audit-server` FAILS) until each name exists in the studio manifest; if the server ships a different name, rename it here and in scripts/mcp_projection_rules.py in the same commit.

omitted_families.site (write): Hosted-site authoring/publishing is app-only on this surface; moda-website routes to moda.app. Site READ tools (website_list/website_show) are 'likely' per the parity wave — not taught until they land.
omitted_families.web search/read: The host (claude.ai) provides native web search and page reading; the metered Moda research lane is not projected.
omitted_families.canvas duplicate / import-pages / import: No connector lane; the app owns reuse-by-copy. Projection says so honestly.
omitted_families.brand create/update/use/pull/images/guid: Kit management is app-only; brand_list/brand_show are the read lane.
omitted_families.org/auth/doctor/describe/last-error/acco: CLI lifecycle machinery; moda_bootstrap and typed tool errors replace it.
